title: IPMA's terms say its logo should accompany its information on web pages
summary: Dinis: IPMA's terms say its logo should accompany its information on web pages; this site has a no-image rule and names and links IPMA on every view instead. Keep that, or ask IPMA?
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
